notes: Both suspectNames are false positives: 'Gold Card' in spikes[0].text genuinely means TF's Gold Card, and 'Land Sigil of Malice (Q)' in wants.foe[0] is the correct ability name in an imperative sentence. Packet defect claims the chart over-favors LeBlanc against TF's 54.15% WR; content whys are kit-grounded (her burst wins 1-2, 6 and first item; skill windows 3-5 and grouped late), so I aligned the full layer to content/packet rather than re-adjudicating rows toward TF — the WR is carried by roam/map play, which the prose states. dosFull[0].d retains the Distortion-return line since its title now matches. report[10].t 'HIS ganks' read as the enemy jungler's; changed to 'their' which is correct on either reading.
